data_caveat: SURVIVOR BIAS: survivors-only backtest universe, so CAGR is an UPPER BOUND. Of ~721 S&P names that left the index 2011-2026, only ~40 are genuine bankruptcies (the rest are M&A / ticker-changes, NOT losses) and are excluded. The failure-bias is bounded but real - not a survivorship-free track record.
